name: goods-in label ocr
// tesseract and zbar: these are system packages, pip cannot install either of them, which is the whole reason this file exists. without it anybody opening a codespace has to know that
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y tesseract-ocr libzbar0 && pip install -r requirements.txt && python make_labels.py --n 60 --seed 7 && python ocr_reader.py
// port 5000: app.py serves here. codespaces forwards it to a real url so the desk opens in the browser with the batch already loaded
